svg.title: 3C lifecycle: one issue through /3c-project-manager
svg.desc: An issue passes a scope and reachability pre-check, a plan and a confirmed branch, a failing test, the minimum code, a commit through the hook chain, /3c-review, the verify gate and the review board. A clean or advisory verdict opens a PR that a person confirms and merges, then a handover issue is filed. A blocking verdict gets one fix cycle; if it is still blocking, the issue goes back to a person.
